confidence_policy: Only individually corroborated metadata and face pairings above .95 with no unresolved issues become Verified. Confidence is judgment, not calibrated probability. OCR/template suggestions are unreliable retrieval aids, never proof.
limitations: Focused group of 71 drafts, not a second pass of all 2,758 prior drafts. Physical reverse confirmation does not resolve missing metadata semantics. No gameplay validation. Interactive GUI testing remains pending.
final_qa: Three direct/reciprocal comparison sheets inspected with saved literal ratings, source panels and neighboring-cell context. Existing metadata names were used to resolve transcription/transliteration variants against artwork and physical counters, never filenames alone. KIC185 pp5/6, KIC120 pp9/10, KIC132 pp1-8 and KIC108 pp9/10. One Black Sea security printed-reverse discrepancy retained. All fronts and 6,897 outside-selection definitions preserved. Previous evidence/issues/notes retained in audit history.
